terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Courtsie. By using our platform you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
body: Courtsie is a platform that connects players with sports venues (padel, tennis, basketball, football, volleyball, beach volley) and lets you book courts, create and join open games, and communicate with other members of the community.
We act as an intermediary. The sports venue itself is responsible for the availability, quality and delivery of its service.

sections.heading: Your account
body: Most features require an account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account.
You must provide accurate, truthful information. Creating an account on behalf of someone else without authorization is not permitted.

sections.heading: Bookings and cancellations
body: Each booking you complete is a commitment to the venue. Cancellation policies may vary by venue.
Courtsie does not guarantee court availability beyond what is shown at the time of booking. A venue owner may cancel a booking for reasons outside our control (e.g. weather, damage).

sections.heading: Community rules
body: You may not post or send content that is unlawful, abusive, threatening, misleading or offensive, and you may not harass other members.
We reserve the right to remove content and to suspend or delete accounts that violate these rules. You can report messages or users using the in-app tools.

sections.heading: Venue owners
body: As an owner, you are responsible for the accuracy of your venue details, prices, hours and availability. Venues are published after admin approval.
You agree to honour bookings made through the platform and to treat players with respect.

sections.heading: Liability
body: The service is provided "as is". To the maximum extent permitted by law, Courtsie is not liable for injuries, damages or losses arising from the use of sports facilities or from interaction with other members.
You are responsible for assessing whether any activity is suitable for your physical condition.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be announced within the platform. Continued use after a change means you accept the new terms.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question about these terms, contact us at {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is a priority. This policy explains what data we collect, why, how we use it, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: Data controller
body: The data controller is Courtsie. For any matter regarding your personal data you can contact us at {email}.

sections.heading: What data we collect
body: Account details: name, email and your password (stored encrypted — never in plain text).
Profile details: photo, playing level, ratings and participation history, when you provide them.
Booking data: venues, dates, times and — for phone bookings entered by the owner — customer name and phone.
Community messages you send to other members.
Technical data required to operate the service (e.g. IP address for security and abuse prevention).

sections.heading: Legal basis for processing
body: Performance of a contract: to create your account and complete your bookings.
Legitimate interest: for platform security, abuse prevention and service improvement.
Consent: for optional features such as appearing in the community (the "discoverable" setting is off by default and you turn it on yourself).

sections.heading: How we use data
body: To provide booking services, manage your profile, communicate with other members and send you notifications relevant to your bookings.
We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We do not show third-party advertising within the service.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
body: Booking details (and, for phone bookings, contact details) are shared with the owner of the venue you chose, so the service can be delivered.
We use trusted providers (hosting, database, maps, translation) as data processors, bound by data-processing agreements.
What other members see: only your name, photo, level and rating — never your email or phone number.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We keep your data while your account is active and as long as needed for the described purposes. When you delete your account, your personal data is deleted or anonymized, unless a legal retention obligation applies.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict and port your data, and to object to processing.
To exercise any of these rights, or to request deletion of your account, contact {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority.

sections.heading: Security
body: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data: encryption in transit (HTTPS), password encryption, per-user access control and minimizing the data exposed in each request.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We use strictly necessary local storage to keep you signed in and to remember your preferences (e.g. language). We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. We will announce material changes within the platform and update the date at the top.
